A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] was a [[New Republic Army]] '''commander''' stationed on the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Altyr V base|base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Altyr V]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]]. He was in charge of the base when it came under [[Battle of Altyr V (Galactic Civil War)|attack]] from two [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] artificial [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]]. Thanks to the efforts of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kyle Katarn]], who destroyed the asteroids, the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] was able to evacuate the base. He then briefed Katarn's apprentice, [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], on her mission to contact the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ka'Pa]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Also, with Kyle gone, we need you more than ever.|The commander, to Mara Jade|<ref name="JK: MotS" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] served as a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[New Republic Army]].<ref name="JK: MotS" /> During the [[Essence transfer|reborn]] [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] military [[Operation Shadow Hand|campaign]], launched by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in an attempt to retake control of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Characters">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' {{C|[[Kyle Katarn]] entry}}</ref> in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">According to the opening crawl of the game ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'', the game's events take place five [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]] after the events of the game ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of the latter game to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. By using simple math, ''Mysteries of the Sith'' can be placed in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].</ref> the commander was stationed on the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Altyr V base|outpost]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Altyr V]]. He was assisted there by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kyle Katarn]] and his apprentice [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]],<ref name="JK: MotS" /> the former [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]]<ref name="Heir">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref>-turned-[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="manual">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'' game manual</ref>

[[File:Four_angry_rebels.png|thumb|left|250px|The commander was joined by Mara Jade and Kyle Katarn during the attack.]]
One day, the Altyr 5 base's [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] detected two [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] approaching the planet. Thinking that they would break up on contact, the commander was surprised when they took up a geosynchronous [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] and began bombarding the base's [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]], revealing them to be some type of new Imperial weapons disguised as asteroids to take the base by surprise. Furthermore, the long-range sensors on [[Delta 3]] picked up an Imperial strike force entering [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. The main Imperial force&mdash;which was large enough to destroy the entire base&mdash;was estimated to reach Altyr 5 in three hours, and evacuation orders could not be issued because of the continuing fire from the asteroids.<ref name="JK: MotS" />

The commander immediately called the two Jedi, and briefed them on the situation, calmly coordinating the base's defenses afterward. The Jedi formulated a plan and separated; while Jade was to remain on the base, to help the commander in the coordination of Altyr 5's defenses against the Imperial forces sent from the asteroids, Katarn successfully infiltrated one of the asteroids using a stolen Imperial [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]. Eventually, he destroyed both asteroids, which allowed the commander to evacuate the base before the enemy reinforcements emerged from hyperspace.<ref name="JK: MotS" />

Katarn, who had found a clue to the location of an ancient [[Dark Force Temple|Sith Temple]] while on the asteroid, soon left for the planet [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] to find it. With Katarn gone, the commander assigned Jade to a mission vital for the New Republic. He told Jade to contact the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ka'Pa]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], in order to convince him to give the New Republic some desperately needed supplies, in exchange for amnesty for all his crimes. Although Jade was at first reluctant to accept the task, she agreed to it after the commander explained to her why the mission was so important.<ref name="JK: MotS" />

==Personality and traits==
The commander had light skin and [[Color/Legends|gray]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], with facial hair styled in a full beard. He was an experienced leader, as indicated by his calm coordination of Altyr 5's base defenses during the Imperial attack. He was also persuasive, being able to convince the reluctant Mara Jade to accept the mission to contact Ka'Pa the Hutt.<ref name="JK: MotS" />

==Equipment==
During the events on Altyr V, the commander wore a [[uniform]] that consisted of a light-brown jacket, which displayed a small square [[Rebel command insignia/Legends|command insignia]] with nine red pips, and white pants.<ref name="JK: MotS" />

==Behind the scenes==
This individual's first and only appearance was in ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'', the expansion pack for the first-person shooter [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'' released on [[January 31]], [[1998]]. He was voiced by [[Terence McGovern]],<ref name="JK: MotS" /> the voice actor famous for uttering the phrase "These aren't the droids we are looking for" in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], and credited by [[George Lucas]] himself for coining the phrase "Wookiee."<ref>{{WebCite|url=http://www.terrymcgovern.com/starwars.html|text=Home Page of Terry McGovern's website|author=McGovern, Terry|archivedate=20171217125955}}</ref>

The officer's name is never revealed in the game, and he is only addressed as the "commander" in the cutscenes.<ref name="JK: MotS" /> Additionally, in the ''Mysteries of the Sith'' game manual, he is named "Rebel Commander", despite the fact that the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] had already been re-formed into the New Republic by the time ''Mysteries of the Sith'' took place. The game manual also showed the Rebel Commander as an AI ally, even though he is shown only in cutscenes as a main character.<ref name="manual" /> His physical appearance is unique in the game.<ref name="JK: MotS" /> Furthermore, because of the nature of the word "commander," it is unknown if it was his military rank, or if it was used as a term to address an officer holding a distinct unit command. The commander's unique command insignia with nine pips has also never been used in other ''Star Wars'' works and the rank it represents has never been identified so far.
